name: depot
description: Depot: composable agent skills, agents, and workflows, as installable Claude Code plugins: everything at once, or one bucket at a time.

plugins.name: depot
plugins.description: Everything: all skills and agents, from idea to verified change. Install this or the bucket plugins, not both.

plugins.name: depot-core
plugins.description: General skills for any domain: skill authoring, decision interviews, session handoff, repo conventions, simplification review, routing, and reviewer qualification.

plugins.name: depot-plan
plugins.description: Planning skills: problem framing, assumptions, outcome slicing, work-item breakdown, dependencies, prioritization, roadmaps, and status reports. Needs depot-core.

plugins.name: depot-design
plugins.description: Interface design skills: research, requirements, flows, information architecture, state and responsive specs, design systems, critique, and usability testing.

plugins.name: depot-frontend
plugins.description: Front-end implementation skills: semantic HTML, component APIs, states, responsive CSS, design tokens, and design-spec intake.

plugins.name: depot-dev
plugins.description: Software delivery skills: refine, build, fix, refactor, migrate, review, reconcile, merge-readiness, security and dependency audits, and release readiness.

plugins.name: depot-agents
plugins.description: The five specialist agents (backlog owner, delivery planner, design reviewer, design-system designer, merge gatekeeper). They apply skills from the bucket plugins, so install those too.
